It's a 2018 Honda Civic EX
Most 2018 Civic EX trims use 215/55R16. Please confirm on the sticker inside the driver's door, then I will check what we have in that size and how many are in stock. — Tread Right Tires
2020 Toyota Camry, I want all-season tires
A 2020 Camry usually takes 215/55R17 or 235/45R18 depending on trim. Which size is on your door sticker? I will look up the all-season options we carry in it. — Tread Right Tires
2016 Subaru Outback, we get a lot of snow

The 2016 Outback typically uses 225/65R17. For regular snow, a dedicated winter tire or a severe-snow rated all-weather tire grips best. Confirm the size and I will check what we have for winter. — Tread Right Tires
My car is a 2019 Mazda3
A 2019 Mazda3 usually takes 205/60R16 or 215/45R18. Tell me which size is on your door sticker and I will check current availability. — Tread Right Tires
2021 Ford F-150, mostly highway

A 2021 F-150 commonly uses 265/70R17 or 275/65R18. For mostly highway driving, an all-season or highway all-terrain tire rides quieter. Confirm your size and I will look up options. — Tread Right Tires
2017 BMW 330i and I want performance tires
The 2017 330i often runs 225/45R17 or 18-inch sizes. Check your door sticker for the exact size, and I will look up summer performance tires we have in it. — Tread Right Tires
It's a 2015 Jeep Wrangler that I take off-road
A 2015 Wrangler usually takes 245/75R17 or 255/70R18. For trails, an all-terrain tire is the usual pick. Confirm your size and I will check what we carry. — Tread Right Tires
2019 Tesla Model 3

The 2019 Model 3 typically uses 235/45R18 or 235/40R19. EVs are heavy and quiet, so a tire rated for EV load and low noise works best. Confirm your wheel size and I will check stock. — Tread Right Tires
2014 Honda CR-V
A 2014 CR-V usually takes 225/65R17. Confirm the size on the door sticker and I will check which all-season options are in stock. — Tread Right Tires
2022 Kia Telluride
A 2022 Telluride commonly uses 245/60R18 or 245/50R20. Tell me which is on your sticker and I will look up options in that size. — Tread Right Tires
2012 Toyota Corolla, just want something affordable
A 2012 Corolla usually takes 195/65R15 or 205/55R16. Confirm your size and I will find the most affordable all-season tires we have in stock. — Tread Right Tires
2020 Chevy Silverado, towing a camper
A 2020 Silverado often uses 265/70R17 or 275/60R20. For towing, look for a Load Range E light-truck tire. Confirm your size and I will check what we carry. — Tread Right Tires
What PSI should my tires be?
Use the pressure on the sticker inside the driver's door, not the maximum printed on the tire. Check it when the tires are cold, before driving. — Tread Right Tires
How often should I rotate my tires?
Every 5,000 to 7,500 miles. Rotation is free every 5,000 miles for tires you bought here. — Tread Right Tires
Can I mix tire brands?
It is best to keep all four the same. If you replace only two, put the new pair on the rear axle and keep brand, size, and type matched on each axle. — Tread Right Tires
How do I know if my tires are worn out?
Put a penny in the tread with Lincoln's head down. If you can see all of his head, the tread is below 2/32 inch and the tires should be replaced. — Tread Right Tires
What does the load index mean?
The load index is the number before the speed letter, like 94 in 94V. It is the weight each tire can carry. Match or exceed the number on your door sticker. — Tread Right Tires
What is the difference between all-season and all-weather?
All-season tires handle rain and light snow. All-weather tires carry the snowflake symbol, so they grip in real snow while still working year-round. — Tread Right Tires
Do I need four new tires on an all-wheel-drive car?
Usually yes. Many AWD systems need all four tires within a small difference in tread depth. Check your owner's manual. — Tread Right Tires
Can you fix a nail in my tire?
Most punctures in the tread up to 1/4 inch can be patched. Sidewall damage cannot be repaired safely. Bring it in and we will inspect it. — Tread Right Tires
What does TPMS mean?
TPMS is the tire pressure monitoring system. The light comes on when a tire is underinflated; check all four pressures before driving far. — Tread Right Tires
Is road hazard protection worth it?
It covers punctures, cuts, and impact damage. If you drive on rough roads or in construction zones, it often pays for itself. I can look up the current price for your tires. — Tread Right Tires
What are your hours?
I will check our current hours for you. Walk-ins are welcome and appointments are served first. — Tread Right Tires
Can I return tires I bought last week?
Unmounted tires can usually be returned with the receipt. Let me look up the return policy details for your situation. — Tread Right Tires
How much is installation?
Installation includes mounting, balancing, and valve stems. Let me look up the current installation price for you. — Tread Right Tires
Do you sell used tires?
We only sell new tires, so every tire comes with its full tread and warranty. — Tread Right Tires
How long does installation take?
A set of four usually takes about an hour. Making an appointment keeps the wait short. — Tread Right Tires
